AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:

been drawn towards media report that the
fish landing along Indian coast is slowing

Marine Fisheries Research Institute in this
regard;

catches;

SHRI MOHAMMED AMIN:

AND FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:

Limited (MFL) has been referred to BIFR
and if so, the reasons therefor;
(b) whether, as per the recommendation
of BRPSE, a financial restructuring
proposal to make the operation of the
company viable has been finalized; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and other
steps being taken to revive MFL?

the Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Public
Distribution System (PDS) in the country
is a total failure;
(b) whether Government are aware that
BPL card holders are not getting proper
supply of wheat, rice and sugar and the

malpractices; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
New rail lines in Himachal Pradesh
*184. SHRI MATI VIPLOVE
THAKUR: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
construct new rail lines in various States of
the country during the year 2007-08;
(b) if so, the sectors where Government
propose to construct new rail lines in
Himachal Pradesh; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Female foeticide
†*185. SHRI AJAY SINGH
CHAUTALA: W ill the Minister of
HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of cases of foeticide during
the last three years, State-wise;
(b) whether Government are
formulating any scheme to have a check on
increasing cases of female foeticides;
(c) if so, the details of this proposed
scheme;
(d) whether Government have any
proposal to set up any type of centre to
prevent foeticide in every district of the
country; and
(e) if so, by when these centres are likely
to be opened and operational?
Petroleum, chemicals and Petro-
chemical Investment Region
*186. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS
AND FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether India would need an
investment of 150 billion US $ to build the
proposed Petroleum, Chemicals and Petro-
chemical Investment Regions in various
parts of the country;
(b) if so, whether an investment of 40
billion US $ alone would be required for
modernization of ports so that they can
handle huge cargo for foreign players as
well;
(c) whether the State Governments and
the Centre have agreed for jointly providing
infrastructure as per policy on PCPIRs;
and
(d) if so, by when the final decision is
likely to be taken?
Milk production in the
country

Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the total demand and supply
position of milk in the country;

improve the situation;
(c) whether Government are following
scientific methods to provide best results

the details thereof;

and milk products would be lifted?
Quality control of bottled water
†*188. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: W ill the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
state:
(a) the total number of companies
engaged in bottled water/mineral water
production and its sale in the country, State-
wise;
(b) whether Government have
appointed any regulator for quality control
of bottled water; and
(c) if so, the details of the complaints
received regarding sale of polluted water
by these companies and the action taken
thereon?
Retendering for import of wheat
*189. SHRIMATI BRINDA KARAT:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) the quantum of wheat being imported
in the current year and the cost thereof;
(b) whether it is a fact that the import is
being made after retendering; and
(c) if so, the reasons for retendering?
Enhancement of agriculture
†*190. SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there was 67
per cent contribution in GDP of agriculture
during the starting of First Green
Revolutions which has now been reduced
to 18 per cent only;
(b) whether it is also a fact that
Government have decided to emphasize on
increased investment in agriculture and
connected sectors of agriculture during the
Eleventh Five Year Plan to change this
situation; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Price for gas from RIL's KG Basin
*191. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS
AND FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether his Ministry had worked
out any realistic price for gas from RIL's
KG Basin in order to enable them to be
more competitive globally;
(b) if so, what are the details thereof;
and
(c) whether any interaction has been
done with other Ministries in this regard
and if so, the outcome thereof?
Completed projects pending for traffic
*192. DR. K. MALAISAMY: Will the
Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the long pending broad
gauge conversion between Rameswaram

60
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
and Manamadurai is completed in all
respects;
(b) if so, whether it is pending to be
thrown open for traffic for want of
inauguration by a VIP;
(c) how many projects after completion
are pending for traffic for want of a VIP to
inaugurate; and
(d) whether there would be a policy
hereafter to put into use the projects
immediately on completion instead of
waiting for a formal inaugural function by a
VIP?
Rail projects in Andhra Pradesh
*193. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of the rail lines laid/
doubled/electrified during the last year and
till date;
(b) the details of the rail lines already
sanctioned for Andhra Pradesh, particularly
in its backward and no industry districts,
but work on which has not been taken up,
so far;
(c) the time likely to be taken to start
work on sanctioned lines; and
(d) the details of the major works to be
taken up/going on in Andhra Pradesh?
Per-capita steel consumption
*194. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of STEEL be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that domestic
per-capita consumption of steel in India is
lower than that of other Asian countries;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the steps taken by Government in
this regard;
(d) whether it is also a fact that though
India is the cheapest producer of HR coils
in the world, but the domestic prices are
the highest;
(e) if so, whether the Cold Rolled Steel
Manufacturers Association of India
(CORSMA) has putforth any demand to
Government regarding reduction in customs
duty on steel;
(f) if so, the reasons for such a demand;
and
(g) the reaction of Government thereon?
New lines from Ajmer  to Kota and
Pushkar to Merata city
†*195. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether he had announced sanction
of new lines from Ajmer-Nasirabad-Boondi-
Kota and from Pushkar to Merata city on
the occasion of inauguration of gauge
conversion of Ajmer-Chittorgarh section in
Ajmer; and
(b) the details of the action being taken
as per that announcement?
Misleading advertisement of beverage
*196. SHRI SYED AZEEZ PASHA:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to advertisements running for
past few months on television for 7 Up
beverage alongwith images of lemon fruit
slices;

61

portrayal of fruit images with aerated water
containing no fruit juice is not misleading
to consumer; and
(c) if so, what action Government have
proposed to take against the erring
company?
Luxury train on Ahmedabad-Udaipur
route
*197. SHRI KANJIBHAI PATEL:
SHRI KESHUBHAI S.
PATEL:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is possible to introduce a
"Palace on Wheel" type tourist attraction
on the Ahmedabad-Udaipur route; and
(b) if not, the reasons therefor?
Claims of Mumbai rail blasts
*198. SHRI VEDPRAKASH P.
GOYAL: Will the Minister of RAILWAYS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that only 174
claims have been finalized at Railway
Claims Tribunal, Mumbai of 7/11 Mumbai
bomb blasts;
(b) the details of the complaints received
and the action by his Ministry in this regard;
(c) whether inspite of Special Bench,
work is very slow;
(d) the details of the grievances,
representation,  etc., received in this regard;
and
(e) in how many months, all the cases
would be settled?
Medical Grants Commission
*199. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
SHRI VINAY KATIYAR:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to set
up a Medical Grants Commission;
(b) if so, the main features, aims and
objectives of the Commission; and
(c) by when it is likely to be set up?
Objections against price of KG
Basin's gas
*200. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI:
SHRI AMAR SINGH:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS
AND FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether his Ministry had raised
strong objections against the high price of
gas from RIL's KG Basin;
(b) if so, what are the details thereof
and the reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is a fact that gas prices
beyond $ 5 per Million British thermal units
(MMBTU) would lead to an increase in

Tuar Board
1364. SHRI K.B. SHANAPPA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have a
proposal to takeover the Tuar Board of
Karnataka from the State Government;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, whether it is not feasible for
the Central Government to run Tuar Board
satisfactorily on the lines of Coffee Board
of India?
Development of Jakhau Fishery
Project
1365. SHRI KANJIBHAI PATEL:
SHRI KESHUBHAI S.
PATEL:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is fact that the proposal
for the development of Jakhau Fishery
Project is awaiting environment clearance
from the Central Government since long;
(b) whether a comprehensive report on
the escalation of cost of the project and a
revised estimate were sent by the
Government of Gujarat to the Central
Government; and
(c) if so, the present status of the
proposal?
Share in global fruit and vegetable trade
1366. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the World Bank Report indicating that India
produces 11 per cent of world's vegetables
and 15 per cent of fruits, at 53-63 per cent
of global prices, but our share in global fruit
and vegetable trade is 1.7 per cent and 0.5
per cent, respectively;
(b) if so, what are the reasons for this
mis-match; and
(c) whether Government would be
evolving some effective modalities, in
consultation with the Ministry of
Commerce and Industry, so that our global
trade share increases and thereby our
farmers are benefited?

316

China

DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in comparison
to India, China is more advanced in farming;
(b) if so, Government's reaction thereto;
and
(c) the reasons due to which the rate of
production is more in China inspite of the
low cost of production?
Prawn production
1368. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to boost
prawn production to touch Rs. 10,000
crores by 2012;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) what is the contribution of Orissa
State in production of prawn; and
(d) what is the action plan of the Centre
to help the Orissa State to develop this
sector to boost its economy?

growing enough wheat as on today so as to

situation; and
(c) the details thereof?

SHRI MOTILAL VORA:

317

(c) if so, by when such centres are
expected to be set up and start functioning;
and
(d) the funds allocated/proposed to be
allocated for this purpose?
Cost of Tuna vessels
1373. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:

derived?

strategies, a food security mission to
augment production of wheat by 8 million
tonnes, rice by 10 million tonnes and pulses

(c) to what extent both State

agriculture on which more than half of the

agriculture has declined and is merely 1.5

(c) whether share of agriculture has

NPM in Andhra Pradesh
1377. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:

announced so far to provide assistance or
relief to the families and schemes announced
for assistance in the event of failure or
destruction of their crops; and
(d) the details of action proposed to
sanction special relief package to these
farmers' families, district/location-wise?

AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:

unavailability of sufficient fertilizers the
production of agriculture and foodgrains
has come down heavily during the last three
years; if so, the details thereof;
(b) the names of the States in which
production of foodgrains has come down
due to shortage of fertilizers alongwith the
names of such foodgrains; and
(c) the plan Government are going to
formulate to meet the shortage?

319
Welfare Scheme for vegetable
producers of Sikkim
1380. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have any
scheme for the welfare of vegetable and
fruit producers in Sikkim;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the total
amount allocated for the purpose during
the year 2007-08; and
(c) the effective measures taken or
proposed to be taken by Government in
this respect?

PANY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:

farming in the country;
(b) whether the States are being forced
to implement this; and
(c) whether opportunity is also being
given to foreign companies for such
farming?

farmers
†1382. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
to constitute a commission to ensure
minimum income to the farmers in order to
check increasing trend amongst farmers of
committing suicides;

state:

(c) the measures being taken to improve

(a) the reason for not processing the

additional funds allocated for farmers in

(d) whether it is a fact that the process
of modernization has been nil in agricultural
technology, if so, the efforts being made by
Government in this direction and the details
thereof?
